## Paper 1 · Pure Mathematics 1

::: {.course-grid}

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.1 Quadratics](paper-1/quadratics.qmd)

- Completing the square and quadratic graphs
- Discriminant, repeated roots and tangency
- Quadratic equations, inequalities and substitution
- 20 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.2 Functions](paper-1/functions.qmd)

- Domain, range, one-one and inverse functions
- Composite functions and compatibility of domains and ranges
- Function graph transformations and inverse graphs
- 20 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.3 Coordinate geometry](paper-1/coordinate-geometry.qmd)

- Straight lines, gradients, midpoints and perpendicular bisectors
- Circle equations, centres, radii, chords and tangents
- Line-circle intersections and distance-to-line methods
- 20 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.4 Circular measure](paper-1/circular-measure.qmd)

- Radians and degrees
- Arc length and sector area
- Chords, segments and composite regions
- 20 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.5 Trigonometry](paper-1/trigonometry.qmd)

- Exact values and trigonometric identities
- Equations in degrees and radians
- Sine, cosine and tangent graphs
- 16 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.6 Series](paper-1/series.qmd)

- Binomial expansion
- Arithmetic and geometric progressions
- Finite sums and nth terms
- Convergence and sums to infinity
- 19 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.7 Differentiation](paper-1/differentiation.qmd)

- Derivatives and chain rule
- Tangents, normals and gradients
- Stationary points and second derivative
- Connected rates of change
- 16 verified Paper 1 question groups from 2020–2024
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.8 Integration](paper-1/integration.qmd)

- Reverse differentiation and constant of integration
- Definite and improper integrals
- Area between curves
- Volume of revolution

19 verified Paper 1 question groups with mark-scheme steps
:::

## Paper 2 · Pure Mathematics 2

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.topic-card}

- Six trigonometric functions and graphs
